definitions.gloss: beginning of the month; first days of the month
definitions.explanation: The first few days of a calendar month. Commonly used in business contexts for deadlines, reports, and scheduling.

examples.japanese: {月初|げっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I submit the report at the beginning of the month.

examples.japanese: {月初|げっしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many meetings at the beginning of the month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{月初|げっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I set goals at the beginning of each month and review them at the end.

notes:
{月初|げっしょ} refers to the first few days of a calendar month. Commonly used in business and scheduling.

MONTH DIVISIONS:
- {月初|げっしょ}: beginning of the month
- {月中|げっちゅう}: middle of the month
- ⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧: end of the month

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月初|げっしょ}⟦ミーティング→ミーティング：05506_miitingu⟧: start-of-month meeting
- {月初|げっしょ}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: beginning-of-month processing
- {月初|げっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit at the beginning of the month

USAGE:
Many Japanese companies organize their workflow around {月初|げっしょ} and ⟦{月末|げつまつ}→月末：00070_getsumatsu⟧ cycles, with reports and reviews due at these times. The reading is げっしょ (not つきはじめ).
